newsitem.title: USA: Jones Intercable to issue more shares.
newsitem.headline: Jones Intercable to issue more shares.

text.p: Jones Intercable Inc said Wednesday that it plans to make a secondary offering of 7.8 million shares of its class A common stock.

The company also said it has offered its underwriters, led by Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc, an over-allotment option to purchase approximately 1.2 million additional shares of Class A Common Stock from the company.

Jones said all of the net proceeds, expected to be roughly $95 million, without the over-allotment, will be used to partially fund its acquisition of the Independence, Mo. cable system from one of the its managed partnerships.
